title: B. R. Ambedkar
summary: Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar was an Indian jurist, economist, and Dalit social reformer who overcame systemic untouchability to lead the campaign for caste annihilation and civil equality. As independent India's first Minister of Law and Chairman of the Drafting Committee, he served as the chief architect of the 1950 Constitution of India, and later led a mass conversion of Dalits to Buddhism in 1956.
